title: Face Sculpt #202 · 일본 20대 · 광기 어린 · 드롭 립 극한 · 둥근 베이비 페이스 · 메이크업 없음 · P50 · 귀 금속 추
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese fresh natural beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and real visible pores, mid 20s, sleek black long hair with a centre part, vivid fiery orange coloured contact lenses with a heart-shaped pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, eyes opened extremely wide with the whites showing all around the irises, a fixed unblinking stare, brows raised, a wide stretched grin showing teeth, a manic, unhinged expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): the absolute extreme of a 'drop lip': a lower lip that is enormous, heavy and pendulous, hanging like a giant glossy tear drop, three times as full as her slim, sharply drawn upper lip, so that the lower lip fills most of the height of the mouth and projects far forward, its dome catching a huge bright white highlight, the upper lip a slim precise bow resting on top of it, mirror-glossy deep rose, every edge razor-crisp, perfectly symmetrical, so that the lips are by far the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view, still reading as a beautiful, believable human face, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about forty-five in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; three small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit seven pieces above the lobe: four classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, two studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and one in the conch and tragus; five small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; three small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; four small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are inspired by the sea: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are round pearl studs, tiny scallop-shell and starfish charms and rings strung with small coral beads. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear oxidized dark copper a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, dark patinated bronze a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, dull blue-grey lead a miniature anvil on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a short chain, tarnished dark silver a pyramid-shaped lump on a medium chain, blackened cast iron a cube-shaped block on a long chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a ship's anchor on a long chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a longer chain, oxidized dark copper a hammer head on a longer chain, dull dark brass a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longest chain; on the right ear dark patinated bronze a hammer head on a shortest chain, dull dark brass a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, blackened cast iron a ship's anchor on a short chain, tarnished dark silver a cube-shaped block on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a miniature anvil on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, dull blue-grey lead a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a long chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a pyramid-shaped lump on a longer chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a teardrop-shaped sinker on a longer chain, dull pewter-grey tin a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a longest chain. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pale gold and silver set with white pearls, mother-of-pearl and pink coral, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
